zlib_note: compressed size / original size of the lower-cased lyric text; lower = more repetitive
pronoun_note: word counts; contractions (I'm, you're, we're) count with their pronoun
sung_time_note: sum of each lyric line's time to the next timestamp, capped at 8 s per line

lines: Can't really trust nobody with all this jewelry on you
My roof look like a no-show, got diamonds by the boatload

first_repeated_block_note: computed, chorus proxy: the earliest-recurring pair of consecutive distinct lines; first_at_s is when it is first sung, recurs_at_s when it comes back. A crude stand-in for time to first chorus.
